text: I walked through town and something was wrong. No music, no party lights, nothing. Then I heard it from every single window: "Hush hush hush!" Kevin was practicing the guitar. Linda was practicing karate. My grandma was doing push-ups. Nobody goes to parties anymore. The whole town is grinding, which is great except now I am the only one who's free on a Friday night. So I threw a party. The only guest was the mayor's goldfish. He's actually a pretty good dancer. Hush hush hush!
